domain: Arbitrary state sets, arity, value preorder, bundles, and compatible liftings satisfying the paper's stated closure inequalities.
quantifiers: For every abstract bundle h_Z, concrete post-fixedness of pull(h_Z) implies abstract post-fixedness when the homomorphism is surjective.
For every concrete bundle h_S, concrete post-fixedness implies post-fixedness of push(h_S) for any homomorphism.
assumptions: The encoder is a coalgebra homomorphism.
The source and target liftings use the same operators and satisfy Lemma 3.11 closure compatibility.
Pullback is order-reflecting for Theorem 3.12, obtained from encoder surjectivity.
Pushforward is monotone for Theorem 3.13 and the required fiber joins exist.
acceptance: A proof kernel and a structurally independent closure checker both derive the two universal goals without assuming either goal; controls without surjectivity and with reversed compatibility are rejected.
non_circularity: The goals are forbidden from the assumption set. No finite state count, sample size, tolerance, or formula-derived budget is used.
